Communicating science beyond academia is an important part of my research. My work on the behavioural ecology, social organization, and reproductive biology of eastern carpenter bees has been featured through university profiles, research networks, scientific publications, outreach activities, and conference presentations.

# University News and Research Features

## Brock Bee Lab Research Profile

My doctoral research examined how environmental variation and social behaviour influence maternal investment, reproduction, and social organization in eastern carpenter bees.

🔗 [Read the Brock Bee Lab Profile](https://brockbeelab.wordpress.com/lyndon-duff-phd-student/)

## PhD Thesis Defence

Brock University highlighted my PhD research examining environmental and social influences on foraging behaviour, maternal investment, and mating frequency in eastern carpenter bees.

🔗 [Read the Thesis Defence Announcement](https://brocku.ca/mathematics-science/2023/11/02/4823/)

## University of Victoria

Currently serving as a Senior Laboratory Instructor in the Department of Biology at the University of Victoria.

🔗 [University of Victoria Biology Profile](https://www.uvic.ca/science/biology/people/instructors/index.php)

---

# Media and Science Communication

## Inside the Brock Bee Lab

A short video showcasing research activities and field studies conducted through the Brock Bee Lab.

🔗 [Inside the Brock Bee Lab Video](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/lyndon-b-duff_video-inside-brocks-bee-lab-activity-6914623848608858113-g6cI)

## Personal YouTube Channel

Videos highlighting the biology, behaviour, nesting ecology, and social behaviour of eastern carpenter bees.

🔗 [YouTube Channel](YOUR_YOUTUBE_URL)

---

# Conferences and Outreach

## BeeCon and BEEc

Research from the Brock Bee Lab has been presented at BeeCon, York University's annual conference devoted to bee ecology, evolution, and conservation.

🔗 [BeeCon](https://www.yorku.ca/bees/beecon/)

🔗 [Centre for Bee Ecology, Evolution and Conservation (BEEc)](https://bees.yorku.ca/)
